Class DatabaseProvider

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.db.facade.DatabaseProvider
public final class DatabaseProvider extends Object
Application-scoped registry for TaDatabase used by servlet init() methods.

init(ServletContext, Path) executes once per container lifecycle (see AppContextListener); callers must not initialise twice unless tests replace implementations via bind(ServletContext, TaDatabase).
